Name: Tired Abigail Reskin
Author: Hughskadoo
Description:
[size=3][center][b]Abigail, the town goth, has undergone a makeover?[/b][/center][/size]

She's ditched her vibrant purple and blue-ish tones for a much warmer and yet quieter colour palette with a couple new addition to her appearance such as a new hairstyle and ear piercings, and who could forget a new pair of glasses to match her jewellery!

This mod only changes her portraits and sprites, this does not alter her dialogue or events in any way, neither does it alter the other townsfolk. I hope to soon work on a mod to alter her dialogue to match her new look, plus to create "tired" versions of the rest of the townsfolk so she fits in a little better.

A perfect mod for those who prefer the more gothic retextures or simply want a little adjustment to their usual Abigail!

[i]Check out my profile for the other characters variations with more to come in the "tired" style.[/i]

Downloads.Description:
Reskins default Abigail to a duller and more visually interesting appearance.

This file has been altered and replaced with a more functional version. (In case you're wondering, a simple typo in my code was brought to my attention.)
